about.title: System Architecture & Research Premise
about.subtitle: Why Bengali Lip Reading is Never Gated by Facial Emotion
about.premiseText: Deceptive perpetrators and high-risk actors frequently conceal hostile intent behind an impassive, pleasant, or smiling facial facade. In high-stakes security checkpoints and interviews, an attacker may utter lethal commands (e.g. 'বোমা', 'গুলি') while actively supressing emotional leakage. Traditional single-stream systems fail because benign facial expressions gate speech analysis. ThreatSense maintains both streams concurrently at all times.
about.linguisticText: Bengali phonetic structure presents unique visual disambiguation challenges: aspirated vs unaspirated bilabials (ব vs ভ, প vs ফ), dental vs retroflex consonants (ত vs ট, দ vs ড), and nasalized vowels. LipBengal combines 3D convolutional frontends with conformer temporal encoders to capture Bengali viseme dynamics.
